blocks.text: CEBU, PHILIPPINES— Optum Philippines, a healthcare global capability center (GCC) under UnitedHealth Group, a Fortune 500 company, inaugurated its expanded workplace at Filinvest Cyberzone Cebu Tower 4 last August. The new site highlights the company’s commitment to investing in local talent through expanded operations and employee wellness facilities. Spread across five floors — with three fully operational and two opening soon — the facility positions Optum for continued growth while placing workforce well-being at the core of its strategy.
